name: Haahashtari
overview: Haahashtari is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Ashhur and Naarah. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture provides no additional notes or descriptions about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Haahashtari appears once in Scripture without an explicit meaning or divine origin indicated. It is presented simply as a proper name in 1 Chronicles 4:6.
familyAndRelationships: Haahashtari is recorded as the son of Ashhur and Naarah, establishing his immediate family lineage. No further familial relationships are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Haahashtari's significance lies primarily in his inclusion in the genealogical records of Judah, underscoring the biblical emphasis on lineage and heritage within God's covenant people. His mention as the son of Ashhur and Naarah situates him within the broader narrative of Israel's tribes, contributing to the historical and theological framework of God's chosen lineage.
